an4.274:1.1: “Bhikkhus, for direct knowledge of lust, four things are to be developed.
an4.274:1.3: (1) Here, a bhikkhu dwells contemplating the body in the body, ardent, clearly comprehending, mindful, having removed longing and dejection in regard to the world.
an4.274:1.4: (2) He dwells contemplating feelings in feelings … (3) … mind in mind … (4) … phenomena in phenomena, ardent, clearly comprehending, mindful, having removed longing and dejection in regard to the world.
an4.274:1.5: For direct knowledge of lust, these four things are to be developed.”
